name: 16686 · Tyrone, PA
findings: ZIP 16686 (Tyrone) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (48% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16686 (Tyrone) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 16686 (Tyrone) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
